snippet.title: For Honor - Official Juren Hero Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at the Juren Hero Gameplay Trailer for For Honor, the hit melee-based action game developed by Ubisoft. Check out the latest Wu Lin Hero in action, who's formidable with any weapon he wields. Juren is launching on January 29 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox One, and PC (Steam).

#IGN #gaming
